capabilities: Pin notes to a home view from the context menu or by drag
Search vault files by title or path
Automatically replace newly focused empty tabs with the home view
disambiguation: Not just a pin manager; it replaces empty tabs with a full launcher view that also includes search and recent files.
extras: Pending Obsidian community review; install via BRAT or a GitHub release. README states it makes no network requests and never modifies note contents. Drag-to-pin and drag-to-reorder are desktop-oriented; auto-open on empty tabs depends on an Obsidian implementation detail that could change.
motivation: The author wanted a focused launcher that keeps key notes one click away without requiring a dashboard note to build and maintain.
problem: New Obsidian tabs open blank, and there is no built-in home view combining pinned notes, file search, and recent work in one place.
summary: Empty-tab launcher that shows pinned notes, vault file search, and recently modified notes in a single home view.
